sections.locator: When can I start exercising after birth? / complete complicated-delivery paragraph
sections.text: If you had a more complicated delivery or a caesarean, your recovery time will be longer. Talk to your midwife, health visitor or GP before starting anything strenuous.

sections.locator: Look after your mental health / first bullet
Look after your mental health / final bullet
sections.text: talking to people about your feelings

sections.locator: When can I start exercising after birth? / straightforward-birth paragraph
sections.text: If you had a straightforward birth, you can start gentle exercise as soon as you feel up to it. This could include walking, gentle stretches and pelvic floor exercises.

sections.locator: Look after your mental health / concern paragraph
sections.text: If you're worried about how you're feeling, feel like you're struggling to cope, or think you may be depressed, it's important that you talk to your midwife, health visitor or GP. Effective help is available.

sections.locator: Look after your mental health / help and rest bullets
sections.text: making time to rest. not trying to "do it all". accepting help with caring for your baby from friends, family or your partner.
